title: Game dev task manager
author: zenith4eva
selftext:
I've been using Trello for task management for my games. Trello has gotten slow and sluggish so I made a personal kanban board that syncs to your github: No server, no account, open source.

  
It's not gen AI game related specifically but it helped me to have this board and update it personally when making games or use the agents to update it for me or track things from it.

comments.author: zenith4eva
comments.body:
Mountain of Tasks is a personal kanban board that runs as a static PWA. There is no backend: your board syncs to a private GitHub repo that you own, and every change is committed there as an event.

\- Full history for free. Every move, edit and comment is in git, with a journal in the app and restore to any earlier commit.

\- Multi-device sync without a server. Two devices merge by combining their events, so concurrent edits don't clobber each other.

\- Offline first. Data lives in IndexedDB, the app works with no network and syncs when it comes back.

\- Your GitHub token stays on your device, encrypted with a PIN or a passkey (Face ID, Windows Hello).

The usual stuff is there too: drag and drop, WIP limits, labels, due dates, checklists, markdown, attachments, a Ctrl+K palette, light and dark themes.

You can try it with nothing to set up. Press "Start now" and it runs on that device only; connect GitHub later and everything you made gets synced.

Code (MIT): [https://github.com/zenith4eva/MountainOfTasks](https://github.com/zenith4eva/MountainOfTasks)
